subject: Friday the 13th
hook: FRIDAY THE 13TH IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK
angle: Friday the 13th is actually slightly more likely to happen than any other day of the week, and according to statistics from the Dutch Centre for Insurance Statistics, it is actually safer to drive on that day than on any other Friday.
angle_support: The 13th day of the month is very slightly more likely to be a Friday than any other day of the week.

Statistically speaking, driving is slightly safer on Friday the 13th, at least in the Netherlands; in the last two years, Dutch insurers received reports of an average 7,800 traffic accidents each Friday; but the average figure when the 13th fell on a Friday was just 7,500.
title: Why Friday the 13th is actually safer
description: Contrary to widespread superstition, data suggests that Friday the 13th is statistically safer for drivers than typical Fridays. Insurance reports show a measurable decrease in traffic accidents on these days.
narration: FRIDAY THE 13TH IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You picture it as a cursed day of misfortune and inevitable accidents. It was closer to being statistically safer, actually proving more secure than any other common Friday. The Dutch Centre for Insurance Statistics analyzed records and found fewer incidents occur on this specific date. While average Fridays see 7,800 traffic accidents, that number drops to 7,500 when the thirteenth falls on a Friday. People are simply more careful, or they just stay home.
